text: dsh-tool-fold 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话显示插件，通过客户端样式和通用设置中的开关，控制工具调用卡片与思考块是否显示。关闭时，这两类过程内容默认隐藏；打开时恢复原生显示，并以蓝色区分过程内容。设置状态保存在浏览器 localStorage，刷新后可恢复。它适合希望收起过程信息、让对话视图更简洁，同时仍能按需查看工具与思考内容的用户。无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-tool-fold hides tool-call cards and thinking blocks in the DSH web client. A General Settings switch restores them and colors process content blue. State is saved in localStorage and restored on load for a more compact conversation view. No API key or external service is required.
想把 DSH 对话里的工具调用和思考过程默认收起来。
能不能用一个设置开关控制聊天中的过程内容显示？
Hide tool calls and thinking blocks to make DSH conversations less cluttered.
dsh-tool-fold 的功能「折叠过程内容」：默认隐藏对话中的工具调用卡片和思考块；用户可在通用设置打开开关，恢复两类内容的原生显示。开关位置由设置槽注册，显示状态由页面样式即时控制。
dsh-tool-fold 的功能「记住显示偏好」：切换过程内容开关时，将开启或关闭状态写入浏览器 localStorage；插件加载时读取已保存的开启状态并恢复页面显示。

dsh-tool-fold README · dsh-tool-fold：Fold all tool-call cards and thinking blocks in the DSH conversation into a
single switch. Maximum collapse: process content is completely hidden by
default; one toggle in **Settings → General** shows/hides everything.

dsh-tool-fold README · What it does：| State | Effect |
|---|---|
| Toggle **off** (default) | All tool-call cards (`[data-chat-flow-kind="tool-call"]`) and thinking blocks (`[data-variant="think"]`) are completely hidden — the conversation shows only user messages and assistant replies |
| Toggle **on** | Everything is restored with native rendering (zero loss); process blocks are tinted with the GUI brand blue so "process" is visually distinct from "result" |
| Persistence | State is saved to localStorage and survives reloads |

dsh-tool-fold README · What it does：The control lives in **Settings → General settings**, between "Appearance"
and "Enter behavior when busy" (order 15).

dsh-tool-fold README · Why "maximum collapse"：Instead of folding each card into its own header (which leaves a vertical
stack of icons), this plugin hides everything and exposes **one** global
toggle — a much cleaner conversation view. No counts, no labels, no icons
cluttering the flow.

dsh-tool-fold README · Implementation：- Pure client plugin (no host code).
- State rides an attribute on `<html>` (`data-dsh-tools-open`), so newly
  rendered nodes (streaming, virtualization) follow automatically — no
  mutation observer needed for display.
- Stable DOM anchors only (`data-chat-flow-kind="tool-call"`,
  `data-variant="think"`) — no CSS-module hashed class dependencies.
- Reasoning blocks (`assistant-step` / thinking) are included in the fold,
  per user preference; assistant reply text is never touched.

dsh-tool-fold README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-tool-fold
```

Restart `dsh web`, then refresh the page. Open **Settings → General** to
find the toggle.
